questions.question: What does God repeatedly call faithless Israel to do in Jeremiah 3?
options: Offer more sacrifices at the altar
Go to war against their enemies
Return to him, for he is merciful
Build a new temple in his honor
questions.answer: Return to him, for he is merciful

questions.question: What does God promise to give the people if they return?
options: Very great wealth and broad lands among all of the nations
Kings as mighty and as powerful as those of the whole land of Egypt
A great and mighty army to crush all of their many enemies
Shepherds after his own heart who will feed them with knowledge
questions.answer: Shepherds after his own heart who will feed them with knowledge

questions.question: Jeremiah 3 compares Judah's faithlessness to spiritual adultery.
Return, O faithless children, declares the LORD; for I am your _____.
I will give you shepherds after my own _____, who will feed you with knowledge.
